svg.title: FPGA CNN accelerator system architecture
svg.desc: Monochrome system architecture of the implemented FPGA CNN accelerator. Solid arrows show payload movement; dashed arrows show commands and control. The AXI data links include protocol conversion for the processing system. Operand preparation groups top-level read-port steering with matrix_agu and vector_agu; the matrix AGU supports CONV, pointwise, depthwise and fully connected layers. drain includes two quantization units and vector output bypass. Block scheduler groups plan_unit, four block_iterator, compute_issue and four pingpong_ctrl. Internal control fanout and valid/ready signals are omitted.
